alate: Alate: only a few characters are recorded. The distance between the ocellus and the antennal socket is slightly greater than the diameter of the ocellus itself, the two being slightly more than equal. The compound eye is situated rather high, with a distinct gap between its lower margin and the lower margin of the head capsule, this distance being about half the diameter of the compound eye.
distribution: In China recorded from Yaxian and Lingshui, Hainan; abroad from India, Sri Lanka, Africa, the Caribbean coast, Central America and South America.
